title: Reading the Mask: Descriptor-Grounded BI-RADS Rationale Generation for Breast MRI Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2610.29358v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep learning based models accurately delineate tumours on dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI (DCE-MRI), but segmentation masks alone do not provide the rationales or reasoning used by radiologists to assess the lesion suspicion. This limits the explainability as well the clinical integration. We investigate whether clinically relevant descriptors can instead be derived from the segmentation masks and their dynamic contrast-enhancement series. We have used Breast Imaging Reporting and Data System (BI-RADS) guidelines as a structured framework. Using these guidelines we designed a BI-RADS decision tree with eight quantitative measurements using radiomics, together with the lesion size and component count, that determine the descriptors at eight nodes. Using these descriptors we generate natural-language rationale using a large language model. The model was constrained to express only the derived records from the decision tree. After applying

translated_title: 解读分割掩码：基于描述符的乳腺MRI BI-RADS推理依据生成
translated_abstract: 基于深度学习的模型能够在动态对比增强磁共振成像（DCE-MRI）上准确勾勒肿瘤轮廓，但仅凭分割掩码无法提供放射科医生评估病灶可疑程度时所依据的推理与理由，这限制了模型的可解释性及临床整合。我们研究了能否从分割掩码及其动态对比增强序列中推导出临床相关的描述符。我们采用乳腺影像报告和数据系统（BI-RADS）指南作为结构化框架，据此设计了一个BI-RADS决策树，其中包含八项基于影像组学的定量测量指标，并结合病灶大小和病灶成分数量，共同决定八个节点上的描述符。利用这些描述符，我们通过大语言模型生成自然语言的推理依据，并将该模型约束为仅表达从决策树推导出的记录。在应用……
tldr: 该论文提出从乳腺MRI分割掩码和动态对比增强序列中提取基于BI-RADS指南决策树的八项定量影像组学描述符，再利用受约束的大语言模型生成自然语言推理依据，从而为肿瘤分割结果提供可解释的临床解释。
en_tdlr: This paper derives eight quantitative radiomics-based descriptors from breast MRI segmentation masks and dynamic contrast-enhancement series via a BI-RADS guideline-grounded decision tree, and uses a constrained large language model to generate natural-language rationales for explainable tumor segmentation.
